title: Swabian, Slovak, and South Slavic Traditions
grammar: Relational reciprocity: egymás iránt and egymással szemben ('towards / vis-à-vis one another')
goal: I can compare the cultural heritage of German (Swabian), Slovak, and South Slavic communities in Hungary.
I can use egymás iránt (attitude towards one another) and egymással szemben (in contrast to / vis-à-vis one another) accurately.
I can discuss folk architecture, local gastronomy, and post-war historical trials such as the expulsion of Swabians.
